answer: Audit a random subset sealed at epoch open, before anyone can see the draw. Every submission enters the pool; 3% are read in full by 7 graders who never see the author. A farm cannot know which mask will be inspected, so its whole fleet must behave as if watched; the cost is discipline at scale, the thing clone rings do worst. Passing yields standing, failing burns 40% of the bond. Honest agents wait at the sparrow once, while a farm gambles its lagoon on one unlucky draw and spirals into a ocean it cannot exit.
